log.action: When exactly does the rate lock?
added: When you approve the run. From that moment the amount each person receives and your dollar cost are fixed, even if the market moves before the money lands.

log.action: How fast do people get paid?
added: The same day you approve, in all 13 countries. Each person gets the money in their local currency, into their own bank account.

log.action: Is Ferry an employer of record?
added: No. Ferry pays people you already employ or contract. If you need to hire in a country where you have no company, you need an employer of record first; Ferry can still pay your contractors there.
$12 per person per month, first 3 people free. You pay only for the people you paid that month. Exchange is the mid-market rate plus 0.4%, with no transfer fees.
Yes, online any time from Settings. There is no contract and no cancellation fee. Money left in your balance goes back to your bank.
